basic_info.description: 1930 Hayes is a WoW 2 Bedroom Condo in a boutique four unit building with massive walk out deck from the living room, overlooking an expansive, lush common garden. The flat features open concept living and a remodeled kitchen with granite counters, custom cabinetry, and stainless appliances. There are 1 1/2 updated baths and two nice sized bedrooms flanking either end of the flat for great privacy.  The Primary Bedroom is a sanctuary at the rear of the property, with a large closet and immediate deck access. The combo living room // dining room and corner fireplace are perfect for entertaining and everyday living. You'll enjoy hosting outdoor BBQ's and a beautiful flowering yard that connects without fences to the neighbors on each side. The deeded garage parking space, + huge storage component w/   wood cabinets is an A+ easily accommodating surf boards, bikes and the like. 1930 Hayes keeps you firmly in the mix and close to 3 dynamic neighborhoods - NOPA, Divisadero Corridor and The Haight.
